# DataMeet attribution

The GeoJSON files under `vendor/datameet/` come from the **Spatial Data of
Municipalities (Maps) Project** by the DataMeet community:

- Project: https://projects.datameet.org/Municipal_Spatial_Data/
- Repository: https://github.com/datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data
- Pinned commit: `9b4d1c2ece54cdeb6f5e8bad9ccad7844f783b17`
- Licence: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**

Required attribution:

> Maps provided by Spatial Data of Municipalities (Maps) Project by DataMeet.
> Made available under CC BY 4.0.

These files are community-digitized from government ward maps. They are **not**
legal boundary notifications and should be treated as `boundary_quality="community"`,
not as authoritative legal boundaries.

Source files vendored:

| Local file | DataMeet path |
|---|---|
| `Mumbai/BMC_Wards.geojson` | Mumbai ward map |
| `Pune/pune-admin-wards_2017.geojson` | Pune administrative wards 2017 |
| `PCMC/pcmc-electoral-wards.geojson` | PCMC electoral wards |
| `Ahmedabad/Wards.geojson` | Ahmedabad wards |
| `Vadodara/vardodara_wards.geojson` | Vadodara wards |
| `Lucknow/Lucknow_city_boundary.geojson` | Lucknow city boundary |
| `Kanpur/Kanpur_city_boundaries.geojson` | Kanpur city boundary |
| `Kochi/KCH_Corporation_Boundary.geojson` | Kochi corporation boundary |
| `Faridabad/Faridabad_Boundary.geojson` | Faridabad boundary |
| `Chandigarh/Chandigarh_Boundary.geojson` | Chandigarh boundary |
| `Coimbatore/Cbe2011Wards.geojson` | Coimbatore 2011 wards |
